propositions: When a bug is closed as duplicate without a recorded duplicates link, the close gate currently falls through to LLM completion verifier and fails with misleading remediation that omits the actual fix: recording the duplicates link.
The gate must hard-fail before any LLM call when a duplicate close has no replacement link, raising CommandError with the exact rebar link command needed.
A duplicates link whose target is closed (not open) must still satisfy the gate — link existence is required, not target openness.
The gate must distinguish between a dead/archived named target versus no link named at all, surfacing distinct error messages for each.
Non-duplicate disposition classes (not_a_bug, escalated) and non-disposition classes must retain fallthrough behavior unchanged when no replacement link exists.
A regression test must pin that _is_live_ticket accepts closed targets and blocks only archived/deleted tickets, preventing future tightening from reintroducing an open-target requirement.
